name: Cubic Gate
summary: A cube keyed to six planes that casts Gate or Plane Shift for charges.

stats.effect:
This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the GM.

The cube has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can expend 1 of the cube's charges to cast one of the following spells using the cube.

***Gate.*** Pressing one side of the cube, you cast *{ref:spell/gate}*, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

***Plane Shift.*** Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast *{ref:spell/plane-shift}*, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.
